verified_facts.text: Each of the hotel's four floors is devoted to a different music genre: Contemporary, Classical, Opera and Jazz.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each floor is devoted to a different music genre: Contemporary, Classical, Opera and Jazz Music.

verified_facts.text: The rooms and suites were extensively redesigned in early 2018, each dedicated to a specific style of music and a particular artist.
verified_facts.excerpt: extensively redesigned in the beginning of 2018** now offers a redefined Prague hotel experience, dedicated to a specific style of music and a particular artist

verified_facts.text: The room interiors were created by Italian designers Rocco Magnoli and Lorenzo Carmellini, whose work can also be seen in many Versace stores and hotels.
verified_facts.excerpt: The rooms' interiors were created by two famous Italian designers, Rocco Magnoli and Lorenzo Carmellini. Their work can also be viewed in many Versace stores and hotels across the globe.

verified_facts.text: Guests have access to the hotel's Music Library of more than 5,000 CDs and DVDs, also available via Apple TV in their room.
verified_facts.excerpt: Aria Hotel Prague's notorious Music Library consists of more than 5,000 CDs and DVDs

verified_facts.text: Rooms have a Hi-Fi audio system with a Marantz amplifier, Apple TV and AirPlay, so guests can send music and photos from their own Apple devices to the in-room TV and speakers.
verified_facts.excerpt: guests can easily access AirPlay to send videos, photos, and music from their own Apple devices to the in-room TV and speakers

verified_facts.text: Bathrooms feature Molton Brown cosmetics and a European soaking tub or a rain shower, or both.
verified_facts.excerpt: a European soaking tub or a stand-up rain shower (or both), a telephone, make-up mirror, hair dryer, Molton Brown cosmetics

verified_facts.text: The Mozart Luxury Two Bedroom Suite has a splendid view of the Baroque Vrtba Garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: The splendid view of the Baroque Vrtba Garden gives this Luxury Suite its unrivalled appeal.

verified_facts.text: The Blues Luxury Suite is a spacious duplex with ceiling windows and a view of the Vrtba Garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge in a spacious duplex with ceiling windows and a lovely view of the Vrtba Garden.

verified_facts.text: The two-bedroom Beethoven Luxury Suite is designed for families, decorated in an elegant classical style and overlooks the UNESCO Vrtba Garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our fantastic Two Bedroom Beethoven Luxury Suite has been designed very much for families. This Luxury Suite is decorated in an elegant classical style and overlooks the beautiful UNESCO Vrtba Garden.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is just across the Charles Bridge from Old Town, within Prague's UNESCO Historic Center.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just across the Charles Bridge from Prague’s positively heaving Old Town, and within the city’s UNESCO Historic Center

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a private entrance to Vrtba Garden, an Italian-style Baroque terrace-garden dating to 1715.
verified_facts.excerpt: the hotel has a private entrance to Vrtba Garden, an exceptional Italian-style Baroque terrace-garden dating to 1715

verified_facts.text: Prague Castle is a 10-minute walk from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Prague Castle and its spacious grounds are 10 minutes’ walk from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: Three historic buildings were renovated and joined by a glass atrium in 2003 to form the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Three historic buildings were renovated and joined by a glass atrium in 2003 to form Aria.

verified_facts.text: The fifth-floor rooftop terrace, open April to October, has a panoramic view of Prague's red-tiled rooftops, St. Nicholas Church and the towers of Prague Castle.
verified_facts.excerpt: Open April to October, its smattering of wooden tables shaded by orange umbrellas gives guests a front-row view of the oxidized dome of the Baroque St. Nicholas Church and, in the distance, the towers of Prague Castle.

verified_facts.text: The ground floor has a light-filled winter garden atrium and a library with a fireplace and 20 red bookshelves of music books.
verified_facts.excerpt: there’s the light-filled winter garden atrium, a small library with cognac-colored club chairs, a fireplace, and 20 red bookshelves stacked with music books

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a small six-seat cinema.
verified_facts.excerpt: the hotel’s smaller, six-seat cinema and its hundreds of DVDs

verified_facts.text: A sweet afternoon tea is included in the room rate; in warmer months it switches to prosecco with savory snacks.
verified_facts.excerpt: A sweet afternoon tea, included in the room rate, is served from 4-5 p.m.; in the warmer months, this switches to prosecco with savory snacks.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's public spaces are all wheelchair accessible, and there are two accessible rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel’s public spaces are all wheelchair accessible, and there are two accessible rooms.

verified_facts.text: Rooms face the inner courtyard, the road or Vrtba Garden, and thick walls, heavy drapes and carpeting keep them very quiet.
verified_facts.excerpt: Rooms face either the inner courtyard, the road, or Vrtba Garden, and all are very quiet. The walls of the buildings are thick, and within each room are heavy drapes and carpeting that muffle any sounds.

verified_facts.text: The tram is two minutes away for sightseeing in the historic center.
verified_facts.excerpt: either on foot or by catching the tram just two minutes away

verified_facts.text: During Prague's frigid winter the hotel has very low occupancy.
verified_facts.excerpt: during Prague’s frigid winter, the hotel has very low occupancy

verified_facts.text: The rooftop was not yet serving food on the reviewer's visit, and the indoor dining room has no windows.
verified_facts.excerpt: as the dining room has no windows, it can feel a bit oppressive
